case_name: Ashutosh Kumar Ranjan @ A.K.Ra vs Sangita Ashutosh Ranjan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: husband-petitioner, the petitioner in the matrimonial suit

facts_of_case: Husband seeks divorce against order dated 25.7.2006; wife alleges defiant attitude of husband leading to mechanical approach in recording failure of amicable settlement.

legal_principles.principle: A wife's hope and belief in reconciliation cannot be unreasonable or unexceptional.
legal_principles.held: When the wife was desirous to live with her husband and was expecting for restitution of her conjugal life she was definitely not geared up to contest the suit filed by her husband involving the allegation of cruelty and also medical unfitness.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to contest a suit does not necessarily mean they have waived their right to contest.
legal_principles.held: In such a situation, when the repeated efforts of the court below and this Court has failed, this much is clear that the matrimonial suit filed by the husband has to be disposed of, because there is serious allegation made by the petitioner against his wife.

outcome.final_order: Order directing payment of Rs. 10,000/- per month and cost of litigation at Rs. 10,000/- is wholly exorbitant; modified.
